objective: Provide bounded cursor navigation for workflow inbox, audit actions and instance history while keeping current administrator pagination and authorization behavior.

requirements.statement: Inbox, done-action and instance-history reads must expose seek pages ordered by created_at and id without OFFSET or COUNT.
acceptance: each seek query has a timestamp/id predicate
each reads size plus one only
response returns records, next cursor and has_more
counterexample: query uses LIMIT offset,size or COUNT(*)

requirements.statement: A next cursor must continue a fixed result set without duplicate or omitted timestamp/id records.
acceptance: equal created_at records are returned in descending id order across two pages
counterexample: continuation repeats the final first-page row

requirements.statement: Seek reads must preserve authentication, tenant isolation, project range and instance visibility.
acceptance: existing visibility/project predicates are present before seek predicate
counterexample: a cursor reveals a row outside current scope

requirements.statement: Append-only indexes must support the fixed filters and timestamp/id ordering for all three reads.
acceptance: V204 contains only ADD INDEX statements

invariants: cursor has no identity or business data

assumptions.text: created_at is immutable after insert for tasks, actions and instances.

measurement_intents.observable: tenant/project scope in SQL and tests
